instructions: Zotero is the user's reference manager: their library of papers, books and other sources, with PDFs and other files, annotations, notes, collections and tags. Use these tools to find and read the user's sources, cite them in a citation style, and add or organize items in their library. They work on the Zotero app on the user's computer, which is started if it isn't running.

tools.name: zotero_status
tools.title: Zotero status
tools.description: Check that Zotero is reachable, and get its version, the libraries (with their libraryIDs) and the permissions the user has granted this app. Call this when other Zotero tools fail, to tell the user what's wrong.

client.description: The name this app gave Zotero

until.description: When the permission ends, or null for never

tools.name: zotero_search
tools.title: Search Zotero
tools.description: Find items in a Zotero library the way Zotero's search box does. Free text matches according to mode. Clauses filter: by:smith, year:2020, year:2015-2020, after:2019, before:2021, in:Nature (publication), type:book, tag:"to read", abstract:crispr, fulltext:crispr (attachment content), added:2024, `added in the last 7 days`, and any field by its name, e.g. doi:10.1038, `title starts with grounded`, `citation key:smith2020`. no and has test whether a field is empty or a thing exists: `no doi`, `has abstract`, `no tags`, `no attachments`, `no notes`, `has annotations`; `number of notes > 2` compares counts. Annotations match by type:annotation, color:yellow, `annotation comment:unclear`. Combine clauses with and/or and parentheses. Matches in notes, attachments and annotations return the item they belong to, unless the query is type:note, type:attachment or type:annotation.

query.description: Empty lists all items in the scope

mode.description: What free text matches: title, creators and year; all fields, tags and notes; or those and attachment full text. Defaults to the user's search mode.

direction.description: Defaults to newest first for dates, A to Z otherwise

file.description: The best PDF, EPUB or snapshot attachment

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

nextOffset.description: Present when there are more results

tools.name: zotero_get_items
tools.title: Get Zotero items
tools.description: Get the full data of items, in Zotero web API JSON, with their attachments and notes.

items.description: The item's fields, creators, tags, collections and so on, plus these

tools.name: zotero_list_collections
tools.title: List Zotero collections
tools.description: List a library's collections, or a collection's subcollections at any depth.

tools.name: zotero_list_tags
tools.title: List Zotero tags
tools.description: List a library's tags with how many items have each. Coloured tags, which the user assigned to number keys, come first.

tools.name: zotero_search_fulltext
tools.title: Search Zotero full text
tools.description: Find where words or phrases occur in the text of PDFs, EPUBs, web page snapshots and other files in a Zotero library, and get the passage around each match, with its page and a link that opens the file there. Matches words, not meaning: every word or "quoted phrase" in the query must occur in a file, ignoring case and accents, and a word also matches words it starts ("archive" matches "archives"). Only files Zotero has indexed are searched, and by default only the first 100 pages of a PDF. Files are listed by when their item was last modified, not by relevance. Use zotero_read_text to read more around a passage, and zotero_search with fulltext: to combine full text with other criteria.

query.description: Words and "quoted phrases", e.g. 'carbon "soil organic matter"'

keys.description: Only these items' files, given by item or attachment keys

collectionKey.description: Only the files of items in this collection

parentKey.description: The key of the item it belongs to

passages.description: Passages with the most query terms first

page.description: PDF page, from 1, for zotero_read_text and links

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for citing, when Zotero has it

offset.description: Character offset in a file without pages, for zotero_read_text

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file, at the page for a PDF

nextOffset.description: Present when there are more files

tools.name: zotero_read_text
tools.title: Read text from a Zotero file
tools.description: Read the text of a PDF, EPUB, web page snapshot or text file in Zotero. PDFs are read by page, with page labels (the page numbers printed on the pages, for citing) and the outline when Zotero has them; other files by character offset. Give an attachment key, or an item key to read its best file. Returns about maxChars characters per call, and nextPage or nextOffset to continue.

key.description: An attachment's key, or an item's key for its best file

startPage.description: PDF page to start at, from 1. Defaults to 1.

offset.description: Character offset to start at, for files without pages

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file

label.description: The page number printed on the page

nextPage.description: Present when there are more pages in the range

tools.name: zotero_get_notes
tools.title: Get Zotero notes and annotations
tools.description: Get notes and annotations (highlights, underlines, comments and so on made in Zotero's reader). For an item, returns its notes and the annotations in its files; for an attachment, its annotations; or give note or annotation keys. Notes come as Markdown by default. Annotations are in the order they're in the file, with the page label for citing and a link that opens the file at the annotation.

keys.description: Item, attachment, note or annotation keys

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for citing

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file at the annotation

missing.description: Keys that don't exist or are in the trash

tools.name: zotero_get_context
tools.title: Get what the user is looking at in Zotero
tools.description: Get what the user has open and selected in Zotero's main window, so requests like "summarize this paper", "the page I'm on", "the passage I selected" or "the papers I selected" can be answered. Returns the selected library, collections and items in the library tab, and which tab is active. If it's a PDF, EPUB or web page snapshot in Zotero's reader, it also returns the file, the page the user is on, the text they've selected and the annotations they've selected; if it's a note, the note. Returns window: false when Zotero's main window isn't open.

window.description: Whether Zotero's main window is open

tab.description: The active tab: library, reader, note or another kind

libraryID.description: The library selected in the library tab

selectedItems.description: Items selected in the library tab, at most 50

reader.description: The file open in the active reader tab

page.description: PDF page the user is on, from 1

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on that page, for citing

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file, at the page for a PDF

note.description: The note open in the active note tab

tools.name: zotero_generate_citation
tools.title: Generate Zotero citations
tools.description: Format items as one citation (with page or other locators) or a bibliography in a citation style, or export them as BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS or CSL-JSON. Defaults to the style the user copies citations with. A style that isn't installed is installed from the Zotero Style Repository if the user allows it.

style.description: A style's short name, e.g. "apa", or its ID

tools.name: zotero_add_tag
tools.title: Add a tag
tools.description: Add a tag to an item. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.
